about: Aphelion's Blender style sheet as data (BACKLOG.md 'Aphelion: Blender assets' B1). validate.mjs reads it. Every material is a key of M in src/ship.js, read from that file as text, and carries M's colour, roughness, metalness, emissive and opacity; there is no vertex colour, no UV and no texture, since the game draws every surface from M. Bytes are triangles x 72 + 8 KiB: the worst case of a flat-shaded triangle carrying its own three vertices (position and normal, 24 bytes each) and three 16-bit indices, plus the JSON chunk. extent is the longest side a class may have, in metres, a sanity bound only; each item's box is the one src/ship.js gives the thing it replaces, held to 10% per axis (x, y, z in three's frame). texture is the largest image side in pixels, and 0 means none.
